# bootstrap_sacf_bp {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
bootstrap_sacf_bp(
  data::Matrix{T}, n_boot::Int, w::Int;
  block_size::Int=1
) where {T<:Real}
```
Generate a bootstrap distribution of the BP-SACF statistic for a single spatial image. Returns the vector of the `n_boot` resampled statistics.
 
  * `data`: The 2D image (M × N matrix).
  * `n_boot`: Number of bootstrap replications.
  * `w::Int`: Window size for the BP-statistic.
  * `block_size`: Set > 1 to use 2D block bootstrap and preserve spatial dependencies.


:::
